root_cause.text: The allocation in `omap_crypto_copy_sg_lists()` used `sizeof(*sg)` (size of a pointer to a scatterlist) instead of `sizeof(*new_sg)` (size of a scatterlist object), causing a 4x under-allocation when the code intended to allocate an array of scatterlist objects.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `kmalloc_array(n, sizeof(*sg), GFP_KERNEL)` to `kmalloc_array(n, sizeof(*new_sg), GFP_KERNEL)`. The commit message explicitly states: "was allocating an array of scatterlist pointers, not scatterlist objects, resulting in a 4x too small allocation." This directly identifies the mis-sized allocation as the root cause.
